name: id
description: Unique payment identifier (hashed). One row per charge to the sender.

name: amount
description: Total charged to the sender in USD, equal to receipt amount_charged + fee. Contains zero and one negative value (data quality).

name: currency
description: Currency of the charge, ISO 4217. Always USD.

name: status
description: Payment status: SUCCESSFUL, FAILED, REFUNDED, PENDING_USER_ACTION or STARTED.

name: detailed_status
description: Granular status or failure reason (e.g. FAILED_DUE_TO_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, FAILED_DUE_TO_SUSPECTED_FRAUD_BY_PROCESSOR). Null for most REFUNDED rows.

name: error_code
description: Processor error code. Empty in the current extract.

name: reason
description: Free-text reason. Empty in the current extract.

name: type
description: Payment method: CARD, APPLE_PAY, CASH, WALLET_POC or ACH.

name: total_intents
description: Number of payment intents. Only populated (value 1) on ~2% of rows.

name: location_of_request_state_code
description: US state code of the request. Only populated for CASH and ACH payments.

name: has_dispute_chargeback
description: True if the payment has a dispute or chargeback. Dispute and chargeback cannot be told apart.

name: created_at
description: Timestamp when the payment was created (UTC).
